# ui-pattern-picker

> Agent skill that shows 531 UI patterns (Korean/English) as live preview cards so people can learn what a UI element is called and get a ready prompt.

- [Install instructions for AI agents](https://github.com/eminoart/ui-pattern-picker/blob/main/INSTALL.md): `npx -y skills add eminoart/ui-pattern-picker -y`, or upload the zip in ChatGPT/Claude
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/eminoart/ui-pattern-picker/blob/main/skills/ui-pattern-picker/SKILL.md)
- [Skill zip](https://github.com/eminoart/ui-pattern-picker/raw/main/ui-pattern-picker-skill.zip)
- [Web catalog](https://eminoart.github.io/ui-pattern-picker/)
